{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify deduplication: should now have 848 - 48 = 800 rows
assert len(df_dedup) == 800, f'Expected 800 patients, got {len(df_dedup)}'

# Now filter to treatment arm
treatment_arm = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute response fraction
response_fraction = treatment_arm['responded'].mean()

# Output the result
response_fraction"}
